name: Epsom salt baths
what_people_do: Soak in hot water with Epsom salt for aches, colds and "drawing out" illness.
why_they_say_it_works: Magnesium is said to be absorbed through the skin and relax the muscles.

documented_by.source: agent4-traditional-practices.md, 12 Nov 2026 (research file in this project)
documented_by.quote_or_summary: Appears in a Root listing of grandmothers' cold and flu remedies (search snippet); page not opened. UNVERIFIED.

evidence.finding: Minimal magnesium crossed intact skin; delivery from a simple solution is unlikely.

source.name: Does magnesium permeate the skin? ex vivo porcine skin, 2026, PMID 42372834

harm_note: A case report exists of hypermagnesaemia after swallowing a bath agent; not a bathing risk.
gaps: A 2025 knee osteoarthritis Epsom bath RCT seen as a title only.
